title: Billing journal, payments and allocations contract v1 (B1-B2; synthetic data only; ADR 0008 pending billing approval)

Cursor.description: Opaque, tenant-bound, HMAC-protected. Never parse it.

CurrencyCode.description: ISO 4217 alphabetic code; must equal the tenant billing currency (422 currency_mismatch).

MinorUnits.description: Signed integer minor units. On journal lines debit is positive and credit negative.

Money.description: SHARED-CONTRACTS Money: explicit currency and integer minor units. Never a float.

SyntheticRef.description: Synthetic opaque external reference (check number, deposit, refund). Never real data.

SyntheticProcedureRef.description: C14 seam: a synthetic rendered-procedure reference until C14 drives charge posting.

SyntheticProcedureCode.description: Synthetic placeholder code only (SYN-, up to 40 characters with hyphens, the C14 code space); no licensed code set is bundled (B-S4).

PayerRef.description: Synthetic payer reference (B5 coverage records carry it; no carrier catalog).

ChargePost.description: B1 charge posting, the seam C14 will drive. Posts Dr patient_receivable / Cr production_revenue. A replacement names a fully reversed charge of the same patient and procedure.

Charge.description: Open responsibility and allocated amounts are derived from journal lines, never stored.

Balance.description: Derived from journal lines posted at or before asOf; never stored. balance = patientResponsibility - unappliedCredit (negative is a credit balance). Covers the patient merge set; merges never relink posted rows.

InstrumentRef.description: Synthetic opaque instrument for the synthetic provider only (B-S1 blocked-on-discovery). Never card data or a provider token.

PaymentRecord.description: Records patient money as a received fact (Dr undeposited_funds / Cr unapplied_credit). card_synthetic needs instrumentRef and calls the synthetic provider; cash and check must not carry one.

ResponsibilityTransfer.description: Moves open responsibility for a charge between the patient and a coverage of the charge patient effective on its service date (B5 seam).

Payment.description: Allocated, refunded, unapplied and settlement amounts are derived from journal lines. Received is not settled; settlement is its own entry.

TimeZone.description: IANA time zone name (Area/Location); unknown zones are 422 invalid_time_zone.

AuthorizationRef.description: Synthetic reference of a recorded authorization (signature) fact. Used once per plan.

EvidenceRef.description: Synthetic reference of the signed-agreement evidence (no signature image is stored).

CardExpiry.description: Card expiry month (YYYY-MM); no other card data.

PlanCreate.description: B3 plan creation. Monthly installments split the contract total evenly (largest remainder to the earliest). The guarantor, when named, must be the current S5 guarantor.

PaymentPlan.description: Derived plan view (B3): balance, overdue, states and the schedule are computed at read time from the terms, the facts, the attempts and the journal; none is stored.

StatementGenerate.description: B4 generation: an audited snapshot of the guarantor accounts from the journal at the cutoff (millisecond precision). Delivery is E7.

StatementFreshness.description: Derived at read time from the snapshot and the journal; never stored.

Statement.description: A generated statement (B4): the stored snapshot, its digest check and the derived freshness.

MemberRef.description: Synthetic member reference (never a real member id).

CoverageRecord.description: B5 coverage: effective-dated (until inclusive), ranked, with the subscriber as a separate patient. Overlap of one rank is 409 unless overridden with a reason.

CoverageChange.description: A new coverage version (the full changeable field set); earlier versions are never rewritten. The payer is fixed per coverage.

EligibilityRecord.description: B5 eligibility: staff-entered (always unverified) or from the fake adapter (verified, unknown on timeout, unparsed when unmappable). Never a payment guarantee.

CoverageSummary.description: The coverage state C12 estimates read (EstimateView.coverageStatus): entered when a usable eligibility record of the current coverage version, checked for this service date, is inside its freshness window; inactive when that record verifies an inactive member; stale when the latest usable record is for another date, an earlier coverage version or outside its window; unknown otherwise. C12 maps inactive (its own status has no inactive value; seam recorded in billing-progress.md).

paymentAssurance.description: Eligibility never implies that a claim will be paid (CL-01).

ProcedureRef.description: A C14 rendered procedure (UUID) or, for a non-clinical synthetic charge, a syn-proc- reference.

FeeSchedulePublish.description: Publish a new version of a fee schedule (created on first publish). A practice schedule prices charges (tenant-wide or per location); an allowance schedule is a payer allowance named by a coverage fee_schedule_ref. A version is never edited; a later version never reprices a posted charge.

FeeResolution.description: The C12 seam: the practice fee and (with a coverage) the payer allowance for one SYN- code on a service date. null means no configured fee; never a guessed amount.

AdjustmentPost.description: An adjustment of one charge. Every manual adjustment is a request another human posts by approving it. A contractual adjustment names the adjudicated claim of its coverage and is capped at billed minus the payer allowance; courtesy and write-off need a configured reason. Service principals post contractual amounts only through remittance ingestion.

ReceivablesReport.description: Open receivables by charge location, derived from journal lines at read time. A location-restricted reader sees its locations only (null-location synthetic charges are tenant-wide).

ClaimPrepare.description: Prepare a claim (version 1) from C14 rendered procedures that have posted charges, for one coverage. Nothing typed by hand: lines are assembled from the procedure, its charge and the coverage allowance.

ClaimSubmit.description: Submit the validated head version through the fake clearinghouse, under the explicit approval of the human caller or a standing policy rechecked now. One submission per version: never a blind resubmission.

rank.description: Benefit rank of the claim coverage (1 primary, 2 secondary).

primaryClaimRef.description: For a secondary claim, the primary claim whose adjudication it relies on.

truncated.description: True when more open claims exist than one page (newest first) shows.

RemittanceIngest.description: Ingest one synthetic ERA-like remittance from the fake clearinghouse by its reference (idempotent per reference: a duplicate changes nothing).

RemittanceSettle.description: Record the EFT/check settlement of a remittance (a separate fact; an ERA alone is never cash). The amount must equal the open clearing balance.

RemittanceAdvice.description: Shape check of a synthetic ERA-like advice fetched from the fake clearinghouse (not X12): every amount a non-negative integer in minor units.

NonNegativeMoney.description: Money of zero or more minor units (a limit that may be zero).

RemittanceLineResolve.description: Resolve one remittance review line as a separate fact. match_claim_line posts an unmatched line against the named transmitted claim line; post_with_adjustment and write_off post the reported amounts plus the residual (billed minus reported) once another human approves (write_off also needs a workflow policy limit); route_to_appeal posts only the paid amount and leaves the rest insurer responsibility.

RemittanceResolutionDecide.description: Approve (posts) or reject a resolution that needs approval; never by its requester.

WorkflowPolicyPublish.description: A new version of the claims-workflow policy data for one synthetic payer (or the tenant default): partner-aware deadlines in minutes, bounded escalation and the residual write-off limit. Earlier versions are never changed.

SecondaryClaimPrepare.description: B8: prepare the secondary claim of a primary claim for a secondary-rank coverage of the patient. Needs the primary paid adjudication and posted remittance (COB evidence); claims only the patient responsibility the primary left.

AttachmentPackageCreate.description: CL-04: bind the head version's object references (I owns the bytes) and their content digests into one attachment package; rechecked before dispatch.

ClaimWorkflowStart.description: Start the closed-loop workflow of a primary claim lineage. A standing submission policy lets the workflow drive validate, submit, poll and secondary preparation through the owning commands; a workflow policy version fixes the deadlines (else the latest for the payer).

VisitPreparation.description: CL-01 visit preparation: coverage status, eligibility freshness and source per coverage for a service date, and the missing facts with their owner. Never implies payment.

ClaimWorkflowView.description: The closed-loop workflow of one claim lineage: linked steps (by reference, never copied state), owned exceptions with escalation, durable timers, open responsibilities per charge and the closure fact.
